name: spellbook
title: Spellbook
description: Save shell commands as templates with parameters and default values, then run, copy or paste them, or ask Raycast AI to fill in the values and run them.
author: netbull

commands.name: search-commands
commands.title: Search Commands
commands.subtitle: Spellbook
commands.description: Find a saved command and run, copy or paste it. Enter repeats what you did last time with the same values; Cmd+Enter adjusts the parameters first.

commands.name: save-command
commands.title: Save Command
commands.subtitle: Spellbook
commands.description: Save a new command template. The command is prefilled from your clipboard when it looks like shell.

tools.name: get-commands
tools.title: Get Commands
tools.description: List the saved commands with their templates, parameters, defaults and choices.

tools.name: run-command
tools.title: Run Command
tools.description: Run a saved command with its parameters filled in, after showing the exact command for confirmation.

tools.name: create-command
tools.title: Create Command
tools.description: Save a new command template to the library.

preferences.name: libraryPath
preferences.title: Library File
preferences.description: Path to the JSON file holding your commands (supports ~).

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal App
preferences.description: Terminal used when a command's run mode is Terminal.
